# Code Anchors: Verdict Repository Scoping

- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/verdict-repos.ts` — resolves both repositories from a checkout: the code repository from the checkout itself, the issues repository from the publishing chain falling back to the code repository, never empty (#765).
- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/verdict-repos.spec.ts` — pins the fallback, and that a checkout whose repository cannot be resolved stops rather than passing an empty value through (#765).
- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/publish-check.ts` — the boundary the gate must pass before publishing: parses the drafted body with the readers' own parser and refuses one naming no repository, or naming another (#765).
- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/publish-check.spec.ts` — pins the approval, both refusals, and the unparseable-body case (#765).
- `libs/pr-acceptance/src/verify.ts` — the effective-repository rule and the one comparison both readers call, where an unknown on either side accepts (#765).
- `libs/pr-acceptance/src/verify.spec.ts` — pins that a verdict naming no repository is accepted against the repository it stamps, and that two known differing identities reject (#765).
- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/verdict.ts` — applies the comparison with the other trust checks, before newest-wins, and carries out the candidates it dropped (#765).
- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/verdict.spec.ts` — pins the ordering against newest-wins and the naming of a dropped candidate (#765).
- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/pr-verdict.ts` — the single-pull-request reader, which stops with its own named condition rather than reporting no verdict (#765).
- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/aggregate.ts` — gathers every story's dropped candidates into the epic-wide result (#765).
- `libs/portable-tools/src/nexus-cli.ts` — exposes the boundary check as a verb, and prints every state of the epic-wide derivation through one payload builder so none can omit the dropped candidates (#765).
- `libs/portable-tools/src/nexus-cli.spec.ts` — pins that every printed state carries them, and pins both stage prompts' promise of it (#765).
- `components/commands/nxs.analyze.md` — writes the repository on every publish and calls the boundary check before either publish path (#765).
- `components/commands/nxs.close.md` — reads a repository mismatch as its own named condition, never as a missing receipt (#765).
